intent: Packetization mode 0: every NAL unit in a packet of its own, so a key frame starts with an SPS alone, and each frame has 4 slices. Slice 2 of P frame 100 is lost, never repaired; the writer drops frames 100-179 until key frame 180. The track buffer asks 200-240 ms after the reveal, and once a second while no key frame follows: 3 requests. Key frame 180's lone SPS ends the asking. RED when the key frame hint looks for the SPS only inside a STAP-A, as mode 1 sends it: it asks again 1 s after key frame 180 (4 requests).
